sections.label: S$NEER appreciating path
sections.summary: The S$NEER has gradually appreciated against its trade-weighted basket since October 2021, consistent with each quarterly policy stance, and this trend continues after the April policy statement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development, and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Since October 2021, the S$NEER has been on a gradual appreciating path against its trade-weighted basket of currencies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development, and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: And this is consistent with the policy stance at each quarterly policy announcement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development, and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: This strengthening trend will continue following the most recent April policy statement.

sections.label: MAS currency basket weights
sections.summary: MAS periodically reviews and updates its currency basket weights to reflect Singapore's evolving trade patterns, and no single currency dominates or unduly affects broad stability.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development, and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The weights in MAS' currency basket are periodically reviewed and updated to reflect Singapore's evolving trade patterns.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for National Development, and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister and Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: No single currency dominates in the S$NEER basket or unduly affects the broad stability of the Singapore dollar against the basket.

sections.label: Trade invoicing and S$NEER
sections.summary: Most global trade is invoiced in few currencies like the US dollar and Euro, while the S$NEER is weighted against major trading partners' currencies and has appreciated since October 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If you think about trade invoicing, most global trade is also invoiced in just a few currencies, like the US dollar, which accounts for about 40% of global exports, and the Euro, albeit to a much lesser extent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: If you look at other currencies, despite some growth in, for example, the Renminbi's share in global trade invoicing, it remains very low, at less than 2%, although that is increasing in the Asia Pacific and in the European region.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Our monetary policy instrument, the S$NEER, is weighted against a basket of currencies of our major trading partners, and the Singapore dollar has been on an appreciating path since we tightened monetary policy in October 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: And that has the effect of dampening imported inflation in Singapore and a downstream impact on our economy.
